details: Bitcoin is currently trading around $60,000, facing significant institutional selling pressure. Spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded $1.72 billion in outflows last week, marking the largest outflows in over a year. This contrasts with earlier periods where outflows slowed near this price level, indicating a more bearish stance from institutional investors and potentially challenging Bitcoin's current support.
title: Bitcoin Nears $60K Amid Heavy ETF Outflows, Signaling Bearish Institutional Sentiment

details: Michael Saylor, Executive Chairman of Strategy, posted his customary "add more dots" Bitcoin acquisition chart on X, signaling a potential new Bitcoin purchase. This indication comes amidst reports that Strategy's significant Bitcoin holdings are currently estimated to be $11.7 billion underwater at prevailing market prices.
title: Michael Saylor Hints at Fresh Bitcoin Buy as Strategy Faces $11.7B Paper Loss

details: Ethereum (ETH) has climbed above the 1,700 USDT mark, currently trading at approximately 1,701 USDT and showing a 9.40% increase over the last 24 hours. Concurrently, BNB has risen past 600 USDT, reaching around 601 USDT with a 5.15% gain in the same period.
title: Ethereum Surpasses $1,700 USDT, BNB Crosses $600 with 9%+ 24-Hour Increase

details: Illinois plans to introduce a 0.2% "privilege tax" on cryptocurrency transactions as part of its fiscal year 2027 budget. This measure targets digital asset brokers and mandates registration, with non-compliance carrying severe penalties including potential prison sentences and fines. The budget is awaiting the Governor's signature.
title: Illinois Proposes 0.2% Transaction Tax on Cryptocurrencies

details: A large whale address has accumulated approximately 1,723 Bitcoin, valued at about $105.58 million, over the past 24 hours. This significant accumulation took place during a period of low-level consolidation in the crypto market, with Bitcoin holding near the $60,000 level.
title: Whale Accumulates 1,723 BTC ($105.58M) in Last 24 Hours
